verdict.rationale: Plausible offers explicit data export (CSV export of stats, GA import for migration), a read-only Stats API for programmatic retrieval of all metrics, and is FOSS/self-hostable (Community Edition), meaning users can fully own and leave with their data in open formats without vendor lock-in. Community evidence corroborates self-hosting as a genuine 'no lock-in' selling point. Missing for 10: no documented full raw-data/database export or bulk export tooling beyond CSV/API, and no independent hands-on test of the export/leave workflow.
